registered_bars.MARGIN_HOLDS: MARGIN-HOLDS: "fires if the new rows land consistent with the 2x class line (every margin > 2 row surviving its first wash step; every < 1 dying) — the class predictor at n>=7 rows; the scalar licensed as an object."
registered_bars.MARGIN_BREAKS: MARGIN-BREAKS: "fires if any new row violates the class line — the margin demotes to a descriptor; the table stands as the map."

registered_bars.operationalizations: row = (root, fact ZEPHYRA); margin = u0 edge / band median; u0 = the t=0 SIGN-ray (e199/e208's convention), kill = first g-12 <= 0.27 downcrossing on the onset grid 0.05..3.00 linear-in-D interpolated; band = middle order statistic of 3 fresh in-span draws' kills on the SAME grid and SAME ruler (the row is same-ruler AND same-instrument by construction); NULL band median (majority-censored) or NULL edge (soft > 3.0) => NULL margin, reported never adjudicated; survival = the seed's C-ARM unwalled death clock from the committed records (first committed ckpt step with g-12 <= 0.27; survival = death_t - 1; R6 bracketed (2,4] on the ckpt clock); violation = (margin > 2 AND survival == 0) OR (margin < 1 AND survival >= 1); gray [1,2] reported never adjudicated; MARGIN-BREAKS fires iff >= 1 NEW defined-margin row violates; MARGIN-HOLDS fires iff NO row anywhere violates AND >= 1 new row has defined margin > 2 AND the extended table has >= 7 rows; GRADED = any residual; composite order MARGIN-HOLDS / MARGIN-BREAKS / GRADED (first two mutually exclusive by construction); the walled survival column and Spearman(margin, survival) are context, never adjudicated.
registered_bars.desk_forced_disclosure: the SURVIVAL side of both first bars is desk-fixed by the committed C-arm records (every seed's unwalled arm survived its first wash step: +1 reads 0.678 / 0.817 / 0.323; deaths at +2 / +4 / +2): any new margin < 1 auto-fires MARGIN-BREAKS; all-new-margins > 2 auto-satisfies HOLDS' survival clauses; gray margins are partials. THE BAND IS THE UNWALLED INSTRUMENT (e205 verbatim): the 20-step wash-history and the in-span draws carry NO wall — the wall is the root's biography (it produced the s300 state), not part of the band instrument, and the honest survival column is likewise the UNWALLED C-arm clock.
